structured_prompt.short_description: A precise technical flat vector game mod icon. Exactly six bronze hub discs sit at the six corners of a hexagon, with straight bronze bars along five of the six sides. The sixth side at the lower left is a wide open gateway of plain navy, and chartreuse pollution pours inward through it. A tall floating scrubber vessel at the centre takes flat angular chartreuse haze into inlets on its left and right, and emits clean teal squares from its cap.

objects.description: Exactly six bronze hub discs positioned at the six corners of a hexagon, one corner at top centre and one at bottom centre. There are six and only six hubs. Every hub is a complete filled circle with an unbroken rim: three concentric bronze rings around a small filled centre, four tiny rivet heads around the outer ring, and one very short stubby bronze connector nub projecting a small distance inward and stopping in open navy. Four hubs are plain warm bronze. The lower-left hub and the bottom hub each have a glowing chartreuse centre.
objects.location: at the six corners of a hexagon
objects.relationship: The six anchor points of the hexagonal chassis.
objects.shape_and_color: Six closed bronze discs, four plain, two with chartreuse centres.
objects.appearance_details: Exactly six hubs, no more and no fewer, each a complete filled circle with an unbroken rim, thin even dark outlines, and a short blunt inward nub.
objects.orientation: Arranged at the six corners of a hexagon with a corner at top centre and a corner at bottom centre.

objects.description: Straight bronze bars running along five of the six sides of the hexagon: the upper-left side, the upper-right side, the right side, the lower-right side, and the left side. Each bar is a straight rounded tube with a pale silver highlight along its upper edge, a thin muted teal inlay stripe, and small bronze rivet heads near each end. The bars give the arrangement clear straight hexagonal edges with sharp corners at the hubs.
objects.location: along five sides of the hexagon
objects.relationship: The structural chassis linking the hubs.
objects.shape_and_color: Five straight rounded bronze bars, warm copper bronze with pale silver highlight and teal inlay stripe.
objects.appearance_details: Straight rounded tube bars with thin crisp dark outlines and flat rivet discs, forming straight hexagonal edges.
objects.orientation: Along the upper-left, upper-right, right, lower-right and left sides of the hexagon.

objects.description: The lower-left side of the hexagon, between the bottom hub and the lower-left hub, is a wide open gateway of plain dark navy background with nothing built across it. Through this gateway a broad band of sickly chartreuse pollution pours inward from outside toward the centre, widening as it enters. The pollution band stays entirely within the picture.
objects.location: the lower-left side of the hexagon
objects.relationship: The intake gateway where pollution enters.
objects.relative_size: a wide clear entrance on one side
objects.shape_and_color: Plain navy opening with a broad chartreuse pollution band flowing through it.
objects.appearance_details: An unobstructed opening with only flowing chartreuse pollution crossing it, contained within the frame.
objects.orientation: Opening at the lower left, pollution flowing inward toward the centre.

objects.description: A tall upright scrubber vessel floating at the exact centre with open navy beneath it. A narrow rounded-rectangle vessel, taller than wide, flat outlined in warm bronze with a thin dark outline, with several evenly spaced thin horizontal teal tray lines across its interior and a small bronze cap on top. Its lower edge is a plain rounded end floating in navy. A short bronze inlet nozzle projects from its left side and another from its right side.
objects.relative_size: medium, tall and narrow, clear navy all around and beneath it
objects.shape_and_color: Tall narrow rounded rectangle in warm bronze with horizontal teal tray lines.
objects.appearance_details: Flat outlined vessel, horizontal tray lines, cap on top, one inlet nozzle each side, plain rounded lower edge floating free.

objects.description: Two flat angular masses of sickly chartreuse industrial haze, one to the left of the vessel and one to the right, at roughly its vertical middle. Each is a hard-edged geometric wedge shape speckled with darker chartreuse square dots, tapering into a stream that enters the inlet nozzle on that side. They are angular geometric haze, not soft round shapes.

objects.relationship: Polluted air being pulled into the scrubber from both sides.

aesthetics.composition: Centred. A hexagonal chassis of six hubs and five bars, standing open on its lower-left side where pollution enters, with a floating vessel at the centre flanked by an angular haze mass on each side. Everything fits within the frame.
aesthetics.color_scheme: Restrained and muted. Warm copper bronze, desaturated teal, pale silver and sickly chartreuse against deep dark navy.
